item.title: Chacha rolls to back-to-back victories
item.description: ON Saturday at the Dandan Ball Field, Chacha Ocean View Middle School celebrated after securing back-to-back wins against Saipan International School and Dandan Middle School, improving its record to 3–1 in the girls middle school division of the PSS-NMISA Interscholastic Fastpitch Softball League SY25-26. The post Chacha rolls to back-to-back victories appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: SIS, MHS V advance to girls soccer final
item.description: SAIPAN International School and Marianas High School V are set to meet in the final of the girls high school division of the PSS-NMIFA Interscholastic Soccer League SY25-26 after edging their respective opponents in Tuesday night’s semifinal matches at the NMI Soccer Training Center in Koblerville. The post SIS, MHS V advance to girls soccer final appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Trump touts economic record in State of the Union, seeks reset ahead of midterms
item.description: WASHINGTON (Reuters) — President Donald Trump touted his economic record during the longest State of the Union address in history on Tuesday, saying that he had ushered in a "golden age" as he sought to project an aura of success at a fraught moment for his presidency. The post Trump touts economic record in State of the Union, seeks reset ahead of midterms appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Iran nears deal to buy supersonic anti-ship missiles from China
item.description: LONDON (Reuters) — Iran is close to a deal with China to purchase anti‑ship cruise missiles, according to six people with knowledge of the negotiations, just as the United States deploys a vast naval force near the Iranian coast ahead of possible strikes on the Islamic Republic. The post Iran nears deal to buy supersonic anti-ship missiles from China appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Green flag on Tinian

item.title: Marpi road temporary repair ensures safe travel, DPW says
item.description: THE Department of Public Works has completed a temporary repair on a portion of San Juan–Bird Island Road (Route 36) in Marpi. The post Marpi road temporary repair ensures safe travel, DPW says appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Casa Marianas helps animal welfare groups expand medical services
item.description: BY providing housing and business support to visiting veterinarians, Casa Marianas, the CNMI’s first co-working hub, is partnering with Saipan Humane Society and Saipan Cares for Animals to address the shortage of veterinary care in the islands. item.title: Hofschneider’s lawyer says settlement ‘right and fair’
item.description: ATTORNEY Sean Frink said the settlement ending the CNMI government’s case against his client, Henry Sablan Hofschneider, was “the right and fair decision for everyone,” arguing that his client had been legally entitled to the annual leave payout at the center of the dispute. item.title: House overrides governor’s line-item vetoes on FY 2026 budget
item.description: THE House of Representatives on Wednesday voted to override Gov. David M. Apatang’s line-item vetoes on several provisions of Public Law 24-20, the revised fiscal year 2026 budget that appropriates $138.9 million for government operations and personnel. The post House overrides governor’s line-item vetoes on FY 2026 budget appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: CUC seeks gradual rate increase
item.description: THE Commonwealth Utilities Corp. anticipates that the adoption and implementation of new utility rates — if ultimately approved by the Commonwealth Public Utilities Commission — would occur no sooner than June or July 2026, according to Assistant Attorney General Tina Ngo in a recent status report filed in federal court. The post CUC seeks gradual rate increase appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.
